Order a copy of Too Long: https://toolong.news/TL009

With just over a month to go until the US midterm elections, Trump and the Republican Party appear to be doing pretty terrible in the polls, with Trump appearing to lose his entire 2024 voting coalition. In this video, we're taking a look at Trump's unraveling coalition and what it means for the upcoming elections. 

Can the Democrats Flip Texas?:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2dqaG4nmNG0

📰 Too Long: https://toolong.news/
🎉 TLDR Party:  https://toolong.news/pages/tldr-party
📖 Read our Manifesto: https://tldrnews.co.uk/manifesto

Our mission is to explain news and politics in an impartial, efficient, and accessible way, balancing import and interest while fostering independent thought.

TLDR is a completely independent & privately owned media company that's not afraid to tackle the issues we think are most important. The channel is run by a small group of young people, with us hoping to pass on our enthusiasm for politics to other young people. We are primarily fan sourced with most of our funding coming from donations and ad revenue. No shady corporations, no one telling us what to say. We can't wait to grow further and help more people get informed. Help support us by subscribing, engaging and sharing. Thanks!

Nate Silver, generic ballot average:
https://www.natesilver.net/p/nate-silver-2026-midterm-election-polls-model 

Pew Research on racial/ethnic makeup of Trump’s 2024 coalition:
https://www.pewresearch.org/politics/2025/06/26/behind-trumps-2024-victory-a-more-racially-and-ethnically-diverse-voter-coalition/ 

Data showing lower income people swung towards Trump between 2020 and 2024:
https://ropercenter.cornell.edu/how-groups-voted-2020
https://ropercenter.cornell.edu/how-groups-voted-2024 

Young people swung towards Trump:
https://www.pewresearch.org/politics/2025/06/26/voting-patterns-in-the-2024-election/ 

New York Times/Siena poll, mid-September:
https://www.nytimes.com/interactive/2026/09/15/polls/times-siena-poll-likely-voter-crosstabs.html 

Lower income voters twice as likely to vote Democratic than Republican at midterms:
https://www.nytimes.com/2026/09/15/us/politics/trump-midterm-election-poll.html 

Third of Texan electorate is Hispanic:
https://www.pewresearch.org/race-and-ethnicity/2026/09/10/the-u-s-electorates-changing-racial-and-ethnic-makeup/ 

VoteHub’s Voter Power Index, Hispanic voters have greatest power in House races:
 https://votehub.com/2026/09/17/where-congress-will-be-decided-hispanic-voters-have-the-most-voting-power/ 

Florida Republican criticises Trump’s immigration policy:
 https://host2.adimpact.com/admo/viewer/d28e3513-556e-43d8-9f31-0432a7e271f6/ https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/sep/20/maria-elvira-salazar-republican-trump-immigration 

G. Elliott Morris, Trump approval by issue:
https://www.gelliottmorris.com/p/data 

NYT, Democrats lead Republicans on all issues except AI:
 https://www.nytimes.com/2026/09/15/us/politics/trump-midterm-election-poll.html?eafs_enabled=false 

US gas prices:
 https://gasprices.aaa.com/?state=US 

Trump says gas prices are a small price to pay:
 https://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/6095554-trump-gasoline-prices-iran-war/ 

NBC News poll, majority say Trump’s policies have harmed economy:
https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/poll-voters-say-trump-hurt-economy-competitive-midterm-election-looms-rcna597868 

Trump’s midterm convention, ‘Trumpapalooza’:
https://www.reuters.com/world/us/what-know-about-trumps-unusual-midterm-convention-2026-09-08/
https://www.yahoo.com/news/politics/articles/trump-asked-republicans-pretend-m-100000757.html 

00:00 - Introduction
01:15 - Trump's 2024 Coalition
02:55 - Collapse of the 2024 Coalition
05:24 - Trump's Broad Unpopularity
06:49 - Conclusion
07:46 - Too Long

In this episode of The Ranveer Show, we welcome Vinay Varanasi. He is a Bengaluru-based storyteller and artist who has accumulated vast knowledge about Sanatan Dharma, spirituality, and Indian culture. In this episode, we will talk about Vishnu and his Dashavataras.

In this episode, we talked about the concept of Vishnu and his various avatars, exploring how he is seen as the sustainer of the universe and the source of life. The hosts discuss the intricate details of Vishnu's avatars, highlighting the symbolism and the stories behind them. They also discuss the importance of sadhana and how it can help people connect with the divine.

This was an amazing episode about Lord Vishnu. I am sure that with this episode, we will gain a bit more understanding of Indian mythology and more. I hope you will enjoy this episode and let me know your thoughts in the comments section.
